en.text: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

zhSimplified.text: 他带我到殿那里量墙柱：这面厚六肘，那面厚六肘，宽窄与会幕相同。

zhTraditional.text: 他帶我到殿那裏量牆柱：這面厚六肘，那面厚六肘，寬窄與會幕相同。

en.text: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

footnotes.text: 41:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

zhSimplified.text: 门口宽十肘。门两旁，这边五肘，那边五肘。他量殿长四十肘，宽二十肘。

zhTraditional.text: 門口寬十肘。門兩旁，這邊五肘，那邊五肘。他量殿長四十肘，寬二十肘。

en.text: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

zhSimplified.text: 他到内殿量墙柱，各厚二肘。门口宽六肘，门两旁各宽七肘。

zhTraditional.text: 他到內殿量牆柱，各厚二肘。門口寬六肘，門兩旁各寬七肘。

en.text: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

zhSimplified.text: 他量内殿，长二十肘，宽二十肘。他对我说：「这是至圣所。」

zhTraditional.text: 他量內殿，長二十肘，寬二十肘。他對我說：「這是至聖所。」

en.text: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

zhSimplified.text: 他又量殿墙，厚六肘；围着殿有旁屋，各宽四肘。

zhTraditional.text: 他又量殿牆，厚六肘；圍着殿有旁屋，各寬四肘。

en.text: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

zhSimplified.text: 旁屋有三层，层叠而上，每层排列三十间。旁屋的梁木搁在殿墙坎上，免得插入殿墙。

zhTraditional.text: 旁屋有三層，層疊而上，每層排列三十間。旁屋的梁木擱在殿牆坎上，免得插入殿牆。

en.text: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

zhSimplified.text: 这围殿的旁屋越高越宽；因旁屋围殿悬叠而上，所以越上越宽，从下一层，由中一层，到上一层。

zhTraditional.text: 這圍殿的旁屋越高越寬；因旁屋圍殿懸疊而上，所以越上越寬，從下一層，由中一層，到上一層。

en.text: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

zhSimplified.text: 我又见围着殿有高月台。旁屋的根基，高足一竿，就是六大肘。

zhTraditional.text: 我又見圍着殿有高月臺。旁屋的根基，高足一竿，就是六大肘。

en.text: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

zhSimplified.text: 旁屋的外墙厚五肘。旁屋之外还有余地。

zhTraditional.text: 旁屋的外牆厚五肘。旁屋之外還有餘地。

en.text: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

zhSimplified.text: 在旁屋与对面的房屋中间有空地，宽二十肘。

zhTraditional.text: 在旁屋與對面的房屋中間有空地，寬二十肘。

en.text: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

zhSimplified.text: 旁屋的门都向余地：一门向北，一门向南。周围的余地宽五肘。

zhTraditional.text: 旁屋的門都向餘地：一門向北，一門向南。周圍的餘地寬五肘。

en.text: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

zhSimplified.text: 在西面空地之后有房子，宽七十肘，长九十肘，墙四围厚五肘。

zhTraditional.text: 在西面空地之後有房子，寬七十肘，長九十肘，牆四圍厚五肘。

en.text: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

zhSimplified.text: 这样，他量殿，长一百肘，又量空地和那房子并墙，共长一百肘。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，他量殿，長一百肘，又量空地和那房子並牆，共長一百肘。

en.text: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

zhSimplified.text: 殿的前面和两旁的空地，宽一百肘。

zhTraditional.text: 殿的前面和兩旁的空地，寬一百肘。

en.text: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

zhSimplified.text: 他量空地后面的那房子，并两旁的楼廊，共长一百肘。

zhTraditional.text: 他量空地後面的那房子，並兩旁的樓廊，共長一百肘。

en.text: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

zhSimplified.text: 内殿、院廊、门槛、严紧的窗棂，并对着门槛的三层楼廊，从地到窗棂（窗棂都有蔽子），

zhTraditional.text: 內殿、院廊、門檻、嚴緊的窗櫺，並對着門檻的三層樓廊，從地到窗櫺（窗櫺都有蔽子），

en.text: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

zhSimplified.text: 直到门以上，就是到内殿和外殿内外四围墙壁，都按尺寸用木板遮蔽。

zhTraditional.text: 直到門以上，就是到內殿和外殿內外四圍牆壁，都按尺寸用木板遮蔽。

en.text: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

zhSimplified.text: 墙上雕刻基路伯和棕树。每二基路伯中间有一棵棕树，每基路伯有二脸。

zhTraditional.text: 牆上雕刻基路伯和棕樹。每二基路伯中間有一棵棕樹，每基路伯有二臉。

en.text: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

zhSimplified.text: 这边有人脸向着棕树，那边有狮子脸向着棕树，殿内周围都是如此。

zhTraditional.text: 這邊有人臉向着棕樹，那邊有獅子臉向着棕樹，殿內周圍都是如此。

en.text: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

zhSimplified.text: 从地至门以上，都有基路伯和棕树。殿墙就是这样。

zhTraditional.text: 從地至門以上，都有基路伯和棕樹。殿牆就是這樣。

en.text: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

zhSimplified.text: 殿的门柱是方的。至圣所的前面，形状和殿的形状一样。

zhTraditional.text: 殿的門柱是方的。至聖所的前面，形狀和殿的形狀一樣。

en.text: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”

zhSimplified.text: 坛是木头做的，高三肘，长二肘。坛角和坛面，并四旁，都是木头做的。他对我说：「这是耶和华面前的桌子。」

zhTraditional.text: 壇是木頭做的，高三肘，長二肘。壇角和壇面，並四旁，都是木頭做的。他對我說：「這是耶和華面前的桌子。」

en.text: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

zhSimplified.text: 殿和至圣所的门各有两扇。

zhTraditional.text: 殿和至聖所的門各有兩扇。

en.text: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

zhSimplified.text: 每扇分两扇，这两扇是折叠的。这边门分两扇，那边门也分两扇。

zhTraditional.text: 每扇分兩扇，這兩扇是摺疊的。這邊門分兩扇，那邊門也分兩扇。

en.text: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

zhSimplified.text: 殿的门扇上雕刻基路伯和棕树，与刻在墙上的一般。在外头廊前有木槛。

zhTraditional.text: 殿的門扇上雕刻基路伯和棕樹，與刻在牆上的一般。在外頭廊前有木檻。

en.text: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.

zhSimplified.text: 廊这边那边都有严紧的窗棂和棕树；殿的旁屋和槛就是这样。

zhTraditional.text: 廊這邊那邊都有嚴緊的窗櫺和棕樹；殿的旁屋和檻就是這樣。
